integrity: All-extension group statement proved using independent square basis, loop normalization and intrinsic directed support. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Explicit three-support binary Cayley evolution algebras only; no minimum dimension, no uniqueness, no impossibility of other constructions for 3|n. An analogous characteristic-zero convolution rank result has prior publication; priority of the combined realization relative to uninspected sources is qualified. Finite computations are only corroborative.
title: Binary dihedral Cayley evolution algebras: a ternary obstruction and extension-stable automorphisms
